Billing Governance

Refund & Cancellation Policy

Last updated: November 2026 • INVITE STUDIO

1. Digital Membership Nature

INVITE STUDIO provides immediate access to digital tools, quota increases, and invitation generation upon confirmed payment through our integrated payment gateway.

2. Subscription Cancellation

Hosts can cancel their recurring monthly or yearly subscription at any time directly through the Subscription settings tab in their host dashboard. Once cancelled, active paid benefits continue until the end of the paid billing period.

3. Refund Eligibility Window

If you experience technical defects that prevent the creation or delivery of your event invitations and our engineering support is unable to resolve the issue within 48 hours, you are entitled to a full refund if requested within 7 days of purchase.

4. How to Request a Refund

To initiate a refund request, please open a Support Ticket from your host dashboard or email support@invitestudio.in with your Order ID, registered mobile number, and reason for the request. Approved refunds are credited to the original payment source within 5 to 7 banking days.
